Each entry is either a plain string, a list of 3-5 interchangeable variants, or (for top-NPC PRESENCE tokens — Edmund Carrow, Hector Finch, Mrs Lyle) a dict of voice-arc stages cold/warming/breaking/broken. The composer picks variants deterministically by hash(turn_idx, token_id). All variants must work in any place the original string worked. Voice: third-person past, methodical, cold, reconstructive — Obra Dinn cartouche cadence, Edwardian country-house register, August 1907.

Una carta no había sobrevivido a la tarde en que llegó.

en: The service bell had not been rung where the bell was the proper means.
The matter had been carried in person rather than by the bell.
The bell board had stayed silent where a pull would have been expected.
A summons had been delivered by foot where the bell would have done.
es: La campanilla de servicio no se había tocado donde era el medio debido.
El asunto se había llevado en persona en lugar de por la campanilla.
El cuadro de campanillas había quedado en silencio donde se habría esperado un tirón.
Un aviso se había llevado a pie donde la campanilla habría bastado.

en: The proper form was observed throughout.
The household form had been kept.
The protocol had been followed in every particular.
The form of the house had been observed.
es: La forma debida se observó en todo momento.
La forma doméstica se había guardado.
El protocolo se había seguido en cada particular.
La forma de la casa se había observado.
